hoist_to_index: JAVA-NULL-01: every package a Kotlin module calls or a published surface exposes sits inside a `@NullMarked` scope. An unannotated Java type reaches Kotlin as an unchecked platform type.

JAVA-NULL-02: `@NullMarked` at module scope cascades to every package the module declares. At package scope it does not cascade to subpackages, so a module without `module-info.java` needs one `package-info.java` per package, added with the package.

JAVA-CONC-05: No preview API (StructuredTaskScope, Joiner) on the main sourceset compile path of any published module.
depth.routing_row: Starting a thread or a virtual thread, choosing a lock, bounding a fan-out, spawning or reaping a subprocess, or reaching for a preview concurrency API
